wing_download.condition: Hover performance with flaps and flaperons deflected; source text says performance accounts for wing-download losses.
wing_download.caution: Do not apply as a universal correction at every nacelle angle or flight condition. Check exact deflections and implementation context.

wake_interference_speed_boundary.meaning: Supplied audit reports disruptive wake-airframe currents fade beyond this speed and no longer significantly affect handling.
wake_interference_speed_boundary.caution: Not a universal switch for every wake effect; verify original report before implementing a hard cutoff.

ground_effect_washout.meaning: Supplied audit says the model ground-proximity effect is completely washed out at 30 ft/s and greater.
ground_effect_washout.caution: Keep this ground-effect washout term distinct from the separate 60-knot wake-interference boundary.
